prompts.text: # Build: Catalog plugin (Plan Studio), r2 Restart of `catalog-plugin`, which died with no commits. Ignore /root/axf-builds/catalog-plugin. Brett wants it live ASAP. Build a **plugin** (not a framework lib) named `catalog`. Replace or extend Plan Studio's existing Catalog view, which today covers only plugins, apps and libs. ## Scope 1. **Inventory** everything: framework libs (`framework/libs/*`), engines (`framework/core/engines`), React components, modules, plugins, apps, assets. 2. **Interactive dependency diagrams**: a physical, interactive graph of what uses what, with drag, zoom and pan…
